'''R2-J8''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] that served [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> he took part in the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] as [[Contrail/Legends|Contrail's]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], though he was damaged before the official battle when his dome was cut off by a [[Neebray/Legends|Neebray manta]] in the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]].
